use_cases: Displaying categorical tags or labels in product listings
Showing status indicators like active/inactive or new/sold out
Marking feature availability or plan tiers in pricing tables
Indicating notification counts or unread states
Highlighting metadata like date, location, or author in content cards
ai_summary: A lightweight badge component with four style variants (default, secondary, destructive, outline) built with class-variance-authority. Features rounded pill styling with configurable hover states, making it suitable for displaying tags, labels, status indicators, and metadata across SaaS, e-commerce, and media applications.
